gbm_population_evidence.quote: A newly suspected diagnosis of GBM based on MRI

candidate_evidence.quote: to investigate the feasibility, safety and tolerability, and establish the biological activity of nivolumab with or without relatlimab in patients with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wildtype newly diagnosed glioblastoma (ndGBM).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: To assess the pharmacokinetics (PK) of nivolumab administered with or without relatlimab during the neoadjuvant phase following biopsy, and prior to tumor resection for patients with ndGBM

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Changes in TILs in formalin-fixed paraffin embedded (FFPE) tumor sections from biopsy to resection during concomitant nivolumab, relatlimab, RT and TMZ
we will be able to evaluate the biological effect (pharmacodynamics \[PD\]) of nivolumab monotherapy and in combination with relatlimab in this setting

role_evidence.quote: Arm 1 - nivolumab alone or Arm 2 - nivolumab and relatlimab (combination formulation)
For Neoadjuvant treatment, only on Arm 2, 69 patients will receive a single dose of 480 mg of nivolumab and 480 mg of relatimab by IV infusions on Day 1 followed by surgery.
All patients in safety lead-in, Arm 1 and Arm 2 post resection in Part 1 Adjuvant Treatment setting will receive 75 mg/m2 TMZ from Day 1 to Day 42 orally.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

source_quote.quote: nivolumab with or without relatlimab in patients with isocitrate dehydrogenase (IDH) wildtype newly diagnosed glioblastoma (ndGBM).
receive RT and temozolomide (TMZ) (TMZ will be omitted in MGMT unmethylated patients)
Establish the biological activity of nivolumab with or without relatlimab in patients with ndGBM by demonstrating the presence of Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes (TILs) in the resected tumor

coder_notes: Randomised Phase 2 perioperative: neoadjuvant nivolumab alone (Arm 1) vs nivolumab + relatlimab (Arm 2), then all patients receive RT + TMZ (TMZ only if MGMT methylated) with nivolumab + relatlimab. Both antibodies coded experimental_combination; the record calls Arm 2 a 'combination formulation' (possible fixed-dose product) but registers them as separate interventions, so fixed_dose_combination left false. Relatlimab is also given in the adjuvant phase of Arm 1 per arm description. MGMT determines TMZ use and the safety lead-in focus but is not an entry or arm requirement (coded exploratory_correlative; could be seen as stratification of backbone). IDH wildtype stated only in the brief summary, not inclusion criteria. PK of nivolumab planned with sample type not stated (unclear).
